# Calendar

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A major space for time-based notes.

## Scope note

- Scheduled events and sessions for time periods: Day, Week, Quarter, and Year.
- Parent context for clusters of notes by time horizon.
- Calendar is a major space for time-based linked notes in Obsidian Ideaverse vault in a PKM system, as well as a synced Neo4j subgraph within a PKM knowledge graph.
- Supported by API routes, Python services, scripts, and agents, as well as Swift apps, intents, widgets, shortcuts, and Siri.
- Also represented by Calendar and Fantastical apps.
